TC_AUTH_007: The platform accepts a half-supplied credential instead of rejecting it: a request with an empty, null or absent username/password returns 200 and issues a token, where 400 is expected. The token is still scoped to the API key's own entity, so this is a validation gap rather than an authorization bypass — but a caller that failed to populate its password would believe it had authenticated with one.
